visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses, wearing a white ribbed tank top and green athletic shorts, stands in a brightly lit room with white tiled walls. He holds a smartphone horizontally, filming a music video playing on the screen. In the background, an elderly woman in a yellow t-shirt and red shorts sits on a patterned metal chair, leaning forward to rub her lower leg. (2) The camera zooms in on the phone screen, showing a music video featuring a woman in a white dress singing in various indoor and outdoor settings. Yellow and white captions appear on the phone screen. (3) The man turns away from the phone, lowers it, and begins singing and gesturing dramatically toward the elderly woman. He moves his arms wide and opens his mouth in an exaggerated manner while the elderly woman remains seated, occasionally glancing at him. (4) The man walks closer to the seated woman, still singing with high energy and pointing toward her as the video concludes.
